name: Santiago
tagline: Andean Views, World-Class Wine, and South America's Most Stable Economy
description: Santiago is the cosmopolitan capital of Chile, South America's most economically stable and developed nation. Nestled in a valley with the snow-capped Andes as a dramatic backdrop, the city offers excellent infrastructure, a booming food and wine scene, reliable healthcare, and easy access to both ski resorts and Pacific beaches within 90 minutes. While not as cheap as other Latin American capitals, Santiago delivers exceptional value for a modern, safe, and well-connected city with First World amenities.

quickFacts.visa: 90-day visa-free for US citizens; Temporary Residence Visa for retirees
quickFacts.safetyRating: Moderate-High – one of the safest major cities in South America
quickFacts.climate: Mediterranean with hot dry summers and cool wet winters

housing.description: Modest studio/small 1BR in Ñuñoa or Santiago Centro

dining.description: Mostly home cooking; cheap set-lunch menús out

healthcare.description: FONASA public + entry ISAPRE + affordable clinic visits. Assumes an early retiree (45–55); older retirees should budget more.

entertainment.description: Basic gym, streaming, free Cerro San Cristóbal hikes

1M.lifestyle: A modest studio or small one-bedroom in Ñuñoa or Santiago Centro, on the modern, efficient Metro. Cooking at home is the norm, with cheap set-lunch menús out and inexpensive Chilean wine at home, and healthcare is FONASA public plus an entry ISAPRE and affordable clinic visits. The Bip! card covers the Metro and buses, and weekends lean on the city's free assets — Cerro San Cristóbal, parks, and the Andes on the skyline. Learning Spanish is essential here; the budget is tight but genuinely workable in a First-World-feeling city.

housing.description: Decent 1BR in a better building, Providencia or Ñuñoa

dining.description: Out a few times a week, casual + occasional mid-range

2M.lifestyle: A decent one-bedroom in a better building in Providencia or Ñuñoa, with dining out a few times a week across casual and mid-range spots. A mid-tier ISAPRE private plan brings solid hospital and specialist access, and transport is the Metro plus regular Uber. A gym, concerts, and weekend outings round out an easy, comfortable rhythm, with the winelands and the Andes both close at hand.

housing.description: Furnished, high-quality 1BR in prime Providencia or Las Condes (El Golf, Los Leones)

dining.description: Dining out frequently, good mid-range restaurants

healthcare.description: Premium ISAPRE — top hospitals (Clínica Alemana, Clínica Las Condes)

3M.lifestyle: A furnished, high-quality one-bedroom in prime Providencia or Las Condes — El Golf, Los Leones — steps from the best restaurants and the Metro. Dining out is frequent, health cover is a premium ISAPRE with access to top hospitals like Clínica Alemana and Clínica Las Condes, and a premium gym and a full cultural calendar are easily affordable. Weekends reach the Maipo Valley vineyards, Valle Nevado's slopes, or the coast — each about ninety minutes away. A genuinely affluent life in South America's most stable economy.

housing.description: Large luxury 1BR/2BR in a top Las Condes or Vitacura building

dining.description: Fine dining several times a week

transportation.description: Own-car costs or heavy premium ride-hailing

5M.lifestyle: A large luxury apartment in a top Las Condes or Vitacura building, with a housekeeper a few days a week. Fine dining several times a week, VIP private ISAPRE cover with an international add-on, and a premium car or heavy premium ride-hailing are all standard. The discretionary budget covers clubs, cultural events, ski and vineyard weekends, and international travel. Santiago's setting between the Andes and the Pacific means both the mountains and the coast are weekend-close.

housing.description: Best-address luxury apartment/penthouse in Vitacura, Lo Barnechea, or El Golf

healthcare.description: International concierge cover WITH medical evacuation (worldwide-excl-US expat plan, priced for 45–55)

entertainment.description: Exclusive ski/wine clubs, cultural patronage, lavish travel

10M.lifestyle: A best-address luxury apartment or penthouse in Vitacura, Lo Barnechea, or El Golf, with full-time household help. Dining is near-daily at Santiago's finest restaurants, healthcare is an international concierge plan with worldwide coverage and evacuation, and a premium car with an occasional chauffeur handles transport. The uncapped discretionary budget funds exclusive ski and wine clubs, cultural patronage, and lavish international travel. Chile's stability and strong institutions make this a secure base for top-tier living, with the Andes and the coast always within reach.
